llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple scam website characteristics: it mimics a famous brand (C.P. Company) without being an official or authorized reseller, lacks any real company or contact information, provides minimal hyperlinks not leading to business legitimacy pages, has vague privacy/policy information, and the WHOIS failed which could be a sign of concealment. There are also no search engine results validating it as a legitimate store, only general scam warnings. Such opaque practices, especially while claiming to represent a well-known premium label, point strongly to this being a fake online shopping scam.
